import React from "react"; import "./About.css"; import Service from "../Services/Services"; function About() { return (
{/* ========================= HERO ========================= */}

ABOUT REHOUSE REALTORS

Your Trusted Partner in Real Estate.

REHOUSE REALTORS is a professional real estate consultancy focused on helping individuals, families, investors and businesses make confident property decisions.

From finding the right home to identifying commercial opportunities, selling a property or exploring investment possibilities, we provide practical guidance throughout the property journey.

{/* ========================= FOUNDER / CONSULTANT ========================= */}
KJ

MEET YOUR PROPERTY CONSULTANT

Karan Jha

Founder & Real Estate Consultant

With a customer-first approach and a strong focus on transparency, Karan Jha leads REHOUSE REALTORS with the vision of making property transactions more professional, comfortable and straightforward.

The objective is simple — understand the client's requirement first, then recommend property solutions that genuinely match their budget, location and long-term goals.

{/* ========================= OUR STORY ========================= */}

OUR STORY

More Than Just Property Dealing.

Buying or selling a property is one of the most important financial decisions for most people. At REHOUSE REALTORS, we believe that the process should be supported by proper information, communication and professional guidance.

Our approach combines property discovery, requirement understanding, market guidance and transaction support to create a smoother experience for every client.

{/* ========================= WHAT WE DO ========================= */}

WHAT WE DO

Complete Real Estate Assistance.

Whether you are purchasing your first home, expanding your property portfolio or looking for the right commercial space, our services are designed around your requirement.

01

Property Buying

Assistance in discovering residential, commercial and investment properties according to your requirement.

02

Property Selling

Professional assistance for property owners looking to market and sell their property.

03

Property Rental

Assistance with suitable rental properties for homes, offices and commercial requirements.

04

Investment Guidance

Helping clients explore property opportunities based on their objectives and investment plans.

05

Commercial Properties

Support for offices, shops, retail spaces and other commercial property requirements.

06

Loan Assistance

Guidance in understanding home-loan options, EMI planning and the general loan application process.

{/* ========================= WHY REHOUSE ========================= */}

WHY REHOUSE REALTORS

Built Around Your Requirement.

01

Transparent Communication

Clear communication and straightforward information throughout your property journey.

02

Requirement First

We begin by understanding your budget, location, purpose and expectations.

03

Professional Guidance

Practical support from property discovery through the important stages of the transaction.

04

Long-Term Relationships

Our aim is not only to complete a transaction, but to build lasting relationships with clients.

{/* ========================= OUR APPROACH ========================= */}

OUR APPROACH

From Requirement to Reality.

We believe every property requirement is different. That's why our approach focuses on understanding the person behind the requirement rather than simply showing properties.

We help you explore suitable options, compare possibilities and move forward with greater clarity and confidence.

01

Understand

Understand your property requirement.

02

Explore

Explore suitable property opportunities.

03

Compare

Compare options according to your priorities.

04

Move Forward

Get support as you proceed with your decision.

{/* ========================= VISION ========================= */}

OUR VISION

Building a More Trusted Real Estate Experience.

Our vision is to build REHOUSE REALTORS as a trusted real estate platform where customers can discover properties, understand their options and receive professional assistance under one roof.

We aim to combine technology, property expertise and personalized service to create a better real estate experience for buyers, sellers, tenants and investors.

{/* ========================= FINAL CTA ========================= */}

YOUR PROPERTY JOURNEY STARTS HERE

Looking for the Right Property?

Let REHOUSE REALTORS help you explore the right opportunity according to your needs.

Talk to Our Property Expert →
); } export default About;
